# Management commands

> Every `manage.py` command the Django apps ship, grouped by app, with its help text and options — read from `src/*/management/commands/*.py`.

Run them from `src/`: `cd src && python manage.py <command> [options]`. `python manage.py help <command>` prints the full argument help, including defaults.

## `enrichment`

| Command | Purpose | Options |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `build_enrichment_reference` | Rebuild data/reference/enrichment/iso3166.json from pycountry and friends. | `--out`, `--dry-run` |
| `enrich_evidence` | Show why a record says what it says. | `--dataset (required)`, `--name (required)` |
| `enrich_export` | Write the MDM export for a dataset. | `--dataset (required)`, `--out (required)` |
| `enrich_init` | Create or refresh an enrichment dataset from a CSV list of organizations. | `--dataset (required)`, `--csv (required)`, `--name`, `--mapping`, `--key`, `--encoding` |
| `enrich_link` | Attach enrichment records to warehouse Company rows via their verified CIK. | `--dataset (required)`, `--no-create` |
| `enrich_plan` | Print the provider wave order for a dataset without running anything. | `--dataset (required)`, `--search`, `--no-web` |
| `enrich_report` | Print coverage, trust and per-provider outcomes for a dataset. | `--dataset`, `--json` |
| `enrich_resolve` | Rebuild the golden record for a dataset from its current claims. | `--dataset (required)` |
| `enrich_run` | Run enrichment providers over a dataset. Resumable: every (record, provider) attempt is checkpointed, so re-running only does what has not been done. | `--dataset (required)`, `--limit`, `--only`, `--refresh`, `--workers`, `--max-fetch`, `--max-search`, `--max-api`, `--search`, `--no-web`, `--searx`, `--user-agent-email` |

## `sec_edgar`

| Command | Purpose | Options |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `bulk_load_edgar_companies` | Bulk load basic company rows (CIK, ticker, name) from SEC company_tickers.json into the warehouse. | `--update-existing`, `--refresh-sec-json`, `--dry-run` |
| `bulk_load_edgar_zip` | Load SEC nightly bulk ZIPs (submissions.zip, companyfacts.zip) into warehouse Filing and Fact rows. Submissions are applied before facts when both are selected. | `--submissions-only`, `--facts-only`, `--both`, `--submissions-zip`, `--facts-zip`, `--submissions-url`, `--facts-url`, `--cache-dir`, `--only-existing-companies`, `--cik`, `--start-after-cik`, `--limit`, `--dry-run`, `--delay-seconds` |
| `generate_edgar_reference` | Regenerate data/reference/*.json from SEC EDGAR APIs (companyfacts, submissions, companyconcept). Requires a valid User-Agent contact (USER_AGENT_EMAIL). Preserves hand-authored schema text; merges live observations and concept labels. | `--cik`, `--ticker`, `--metadata-cik`, `--reference-dir`, `--delay`, `--with-accounting` |
| `ingest_htm` | Ingest an HTM filing into the warehouse (shared service with API). | `--url (required)`, `--ticker`, `--cik` |
| `ingest_submission` | Download a full SEC submission .txt and decompose it into FilingDocument rows. | `--url (required)`, `--ticker`, `--cik`, `--no-extract` |
| `sync_accounting_reference` | Merge data/reference/sources/accounting/acct_facts.csv and acct_facts_overlay.json into data/reference/generated/us_gaap_account_map.json (overlay wins per concept). | `--accounting-sources-dir`, `--reference-dir` |
| `sync_company_facts` | Fetch SEC companyfacts JSON and load into warehouse.Fact for a ticker. | `--ticker (required)` |
| `sync_leadership` | Extract leadership positions from a company's recent SEC ownership filings. | `--ticker`, `--cik`, `--limit` |
| `sync_listed_issuers` | Fetch SEC company_tickers.json and upsert all rows into warehouse.ListedIssuer (DB-first issuer directory). | — |
| `sync_sic_reference` | Fetch the SEC SIC code list page, parse the HTML table, and write sic_codes.json (default: &lt;project&gt;/data/reference/sic_codes.json). Requires a valid User-Agent contact. | `--output`, `--url` |
| `sync_submissions` | Pull SEC submissions index for a company (CIK) into Filing rows. | `--ticker`, `--cik`, `--force-refresh` |
